messages:
Maya: Quick question  I ended the year with 14h PTO. We have a product launch week in Jan (blackout Jan 12-16). Can I convert 4h of PTO into sick bank and carry 8h into Jan? Manager Jon is on travel.
Jon: I'm on flight but I approve 8h carryover. Converting any PTO to sick needs medical documentation or Benefits approval, though.
Maya: I dont have a medical note  just a lingering cold earlier. Was hoping for a one-time reclass so I can preserve days during launch week.
Derek (People Ops): Short answer: policy allows 8h carryover max. Conversion to sick without medical documentation is not standard. But we do review requests for business continuity reasons (e.g., critical launch coverage) as a special case.
Maya: If the team needs coverage, Im willing to move some days around. What's the formal flow to request an exception for reclassification?
Derek: File CE-3301 (carryover/reclass request) at https://redwood.company/hr/pto-exception and include manager note + coverage plan. If manager is OOO, manager must delegate approval in BambooHR or here in thread. Payroll cutoff for the Jan ledger is 2026-01-06 18:00 UTC.
Jon: Delegating to @Lina while I'm away. Lina can approve schedule swaps and any carryover/categorization for my directs.
Lina: I accept delegation for Maya (2026-01-08 to 2026-01-20). For reclassification, submit CE-3301 with a short coverage plan (who will cover concrete tasks during launch).
Maya: Submitted CE-3301. Coverage: Derek and Priya will pair on launch-day on-call; I've lined up a runbook and handoff notes. No medical docs.
Benefits Bot: CE-3301 received: reason="launch continuity"; no medical doc attached. Benefits will review discretionary reclass requests within 48 hours.
Derek: Thanks Maya. Two notes: (1) we cant guarantee reclassification to paid sick without docs; (2) alternative: split 4h into 2h unpaid + 2h carryover if team prefers. Which option do you want us to consider?
Maya: I'd prefer keep it paid if possible. If not, I'll do split. Please prioritize review  launch is Jan 12.
Benefits Bot: Benefits review: Approve provisional reclassification of 4h PTO -> "launch reserve" (paid) pending HR audit. This is a one-time allowance tied to CE-3301 and manager delegation. Final confirmation after payroll review.
Payroll Bot: Noted CE-3301. Payroll requires final HR approval and delegation in BambooHR before cutoff 2026-01-06 18:00 UTC to process as paid in Jan ledger. Otherwise default is 8h carryover + 6h forfeited/payout depending on employee choice.
Maya: I updated BambooHR with Lina's delegation note and linked CE-3301.
Jon: Back on wifi, saw this. Thanks Lina.
Lina: Final check  I approved the provisional reclass in BambooHR and attached the coverage plan.
Derek: Logging DOC-3720 to capture this as a precedent: "discretionary reclass for product launch continuity" so Benefits and Legal can discuss a clearer policy.
Maya: Huge thanks. If payroll posts confirmation, is it visible here?
Payroll Bot: Payroll will post final confirmation here after run (estimated 2026-01-07 12:00 UTC). If CE-3301 finalizes, Maya will see 4h appear as "launch reserve (paid)" in PTO ledger.
Maya: Awesome  appreciate the help :raised_hands:
Derek: Closing loop once payroll confirms. Reminder to team: use CE flow + delegation for any manager OOO cases to avoid missed processing.
People Ops Bot: Thread status: pending payroll finalization for CE-3301."
